source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 23 (PDF 101-117), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 23 (Carbonyl Compounds and Carboxylic Acids) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is a carbonyl group? Name the two classes of compounds that contain it.
(Carbonyl group kya hai? Woh do classes batayein jin mein yeh hota hai.)
blocks.explanation: Structural unit >C=O ko carbonyl group kehte hain. Aldehydes (RCHO) aur ketones (RCOR') woh classes hain jin mein carbonyl group hota hai.

book_ref.quote: the structural unit >C=O is known as carbonyl group

blocks.prompt:
2 Where are aldehydes found in nature, and where are ketones used? Give one example.
(Aldehydes qudrat mein kahan milte hain aur ketones kahan istemal hote hain? Aik misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Aldehydes bahut se masalon, phalon aur qudrati khushbuon mein hote hain (jaise benzaldehyde karwe badam ki khushbu aur zaiqa deta hai). Ketones dawaon, chemicals aur paint ki sanat mein istemal hote hain; sab se aam ketone acetone nail polish remover mein hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Ketones used in pharmaceuticals, chemicals, and paint industries.

blocks.prompt:
3 Why is ethanal distilled off as soon as it is formed during the oxidation of ethanol?
(Ethanol ki oxidation mein ethanal ko bante hi distil kyun kar liya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Agar ethanal acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ wale mixture mein rahe to mazeed oxidise ho kar ethanoic acid ban jata hai. Bante hi distil karne se yeh mazeed oxidation ruk jati hai.

book_ref.quote: This prevents the further oxidation of ethanal to ethanoic acids.

blocks.prompt:
4 At what temperature is the mixture kept during the preparation of ethanal, and why?
(Ethanal ki tayyari mein mixture ka temperature kitna rakha jata hai aur kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Ethanal (acetaldehyde) ke boiling point se zyada magar ethanol ke boiling point se kam. Ethanol ka boiling point zyada hai, is liye ethanal distil ho jata hai aur ethanol flask mein rehta hai; khalis ethanal redistillation se milta hai.

book_ref.quote: since ethanol has higher boiling point than that of acetaldehyde

blocks.prompt:
5 Why is a ketone not distilled off immediately when it is prepared from a secondary alcohol?
(Secondary alcohol se ketone banate waqt ise foran distil kyun nahi kiya jata?)
blocks.explanation: In conditions mein ketones carboxylic acids mein tabdeel nahi hote, is liye mazeed oxidation ka khatra nahi aur ketone ko foran nikalne ki zaroorat nahi.

book_ref.quote: therefore ketone is not distilled off immediately

blocks.prompt:
6 What is formalin? Give one use.
(Formalin kya hai? Is ka aik istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Methanal (formaldehyde), HCHO, room temperature par gas hai; is ka 40 % aqueous solution formalin kehlata hai. Is ki tez, chubhti (pungent) boo hai aur yeh biological specimens mehfooz karne mein istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: HCHO is methanal (formaldehyde), not methanol (CH₃OH).

blocks.prompt:
7 How is propanone prepared from propan-2-ol? Write the equation.
(Propan-2-ol se propanone kaise banaya jata hai? Equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Secondary alcohol ko acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ ke saath garam kar ke oxidise karne se:
CH₃–CH(OH)–CH₃ + [O] → CH₃–CO–CH₃ + H₂O

book_ref.quote: Ketones are prepared by the oxidation of secondary alcohols.

blocks.prompt:
8 Differentiate between the preparation of aldehydes and ketones from alcohols.
(Alcohols se aldehydes aur ketones ki tayyari mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono alcohol ko acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ (ya KMnO₄) se oxidise kar ke bante hain; farq yeh hai:

book_ref.quote: Aldehydes are prepared by the oxidation of primary alcohols

rows: Bante hi distil kar liya jata hai
Mazeed oxidise ho kar carboxylic acid ban sakta hai
In conditions mein carboxylic acid nahi banta

blocks.prompt:
9 Name the two basic types of reactions of carbonyl compounds.
(Carbonyl compounds ke do bunyadi reactions ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: >C=O group aldehydes aur ketones ki chemistry chalata hai. In ke do bunyadi reactions: (1) nucleophilic addition reactions, (2) alpha (α) carbon specific reactions.

book_ref.quote: There are two basic reactions of carbonyl compounds.

blocks.prompt:
10 Describe the hybridization and bonding of the carbonyl group.
(Carbonyl group ki hybridization aur bonding bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: >C=O mein carbon aur oxygen dono sp² hybridized hain. Carbon oxygen se double bond (aik σ aur aik π) aur do doosre groups se single bonds se juda hai; group planar (chapta) hai.

book_ref.quote: Carbon is bonded to an oxygen atom through a double bond

blocks.prompt:
11 Why is the carbonyl group polar? Which atom is attacked by a nucleophile?
(Carbonyl group polar kyun hai? Nucleophile kis atom par hamla karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Oxygen carbon se zyada electronegative hai, is liye oxygen par δ⁻ aur carbon par δ⁺ aata hai. δ⁺ wala carbonyl carbon electrophilic hai aur nucleophiles is par hamla karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Carbonyl group is polar in nature because oxygen, being more electronegative

blocks.prompt:
12 Give two reasons why the carbonyl group readily undergoes addition reactions.
(Carbonyl group aasani se addition reactions kyun karta hai? Do wajuhat dein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) C=O ka π bond aasani se toot jata hai, is liye double bond addition kar sakta hai. (2) Group ki planar shape carbonyl carbon ko khula (uncrowded) rakhti hai jo addition mein mazeed madad deti hai.

book_ref.quote: planar shape of the group makes the carbonyl carbon uncrowded

blocks.prompt:
13 Why are aldehydes more reactive than ketones towards nucleophiles?
(Nucleophiles ke liye aldehydes ketones se zyada reactive kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: (1) Ketone mein do alkyl groups ka electron releasing (inductive) effect carbonyl carbon ka positive charge kam karta hai, is liye hamla mushkil hota hai. (2) Do alkyl groups hamla karne wale nucleophile ka rasta rokte hain (steric hindrance).

book_ref.quote: the electron releasing (inductive) effect of two alkyl groups reduces the positive charge

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Aldehyde mein carbonyl carbon par aik taraf sirf H hai, is liye carbon zyada δ⁺ aur khula hai. Ketone mein dono taraf alkyl groups hain: woh electrons de kar δ⁺ kam karte hain aur jagah bhi gher lete hain, is liye nucleophile ka pohanchna mushkil hai.

blocks.prompt:
14 What is steric hindrance? How does it affect the reactivity of ketones?
(Steric hindrance kya hai? Yeh ketones ki reactivity par kya asar dalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Steric hindrance reaction ki jagah ke ird gird bare groups ka hamla karne wale group ka rasta rokna hai. Ketone ke do alkyl groups nucleophile ki raah mein aate hain, is liye ketones aldehydes se kam reactive hain.

book_ref.quote: This is also called steric hindrance.

blocks.prompt:
15 Give the IUPAC name of (CH₃)₂CHCOCH₂CH₃ and state the rule used.
((CH₃)₂CHCOCH₂CH₃ ka IUPAC naam likhein aur istemal hone wala rule batayein.)
blocks.explanation: 2-Methylpentan-3-one. Lowest numbers ke rule se chain C=O aur branch ke qareeb wale sire se gini jati hai, is liye methyl group C-2 par hai (C-4 par nahi).

book_ref.quote: the chain is numbered from the end nearer the C=O and the branch

blocks.prompt:
16 How is HCN provided for its addition to carbonyl compounds, and why is it not used directly?
(Carbonyl compounds mein addition ke liye HCN kaise mohayya ki jati hai aur seedhi kyun istemal nahi hoti?)
blocks.explanation: HCN intehai zehreeli gas hai, is liye seedhi istemal nahi hoti. Ise carbonyl compound wale NaCN ya KCN ke aqueous solution mein aahista mineral acid (HCl) dal kar mixture hi mein banaya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Instead, it is produced by adding slowly a mineral acid (HCl) to a mixture

blocks.prompt:
17 Why is a slight excess of KCN used in the addition of HCN to a carbonyl compound?
(Carbonyl compound mein HCN ke addition mein KCN thora zyada kyun liya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: HCN na nucleophile hai (is ke carbon par lone pair nahi) na strong acid, is liye CN⁻ bahut kam deta hai. Thora zyada KCN free CN⁻ ions deta hai jo reaction shuru karte aur munasib raftaar se chalate hain.

book_ref.quote: These free ions start the reaction and catalyse it to move at a reasonable rate.

blocks.prompt:
18 Write the reaction of propanone with HCN and name the product. Give its use.
(Propanone ka HCN se reaction likhein aur product ka naam batayein. Is ka istemal bhi likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
CH₃COCH₃ + HCN → (CH₃)₂C(OH)CN
Product 2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanenitrile hai, aik cyanohydrin; yeh Perspex banane mein intermediate ke taur par istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Propanone and HCN give 2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanenitrile

blocks.prompt:
19 Cyanohydrin formation is reversible. Why is the yield still high?
(Cyanohydrin banna reversible hai. Phir bhi yield zyada kyun hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cyanohydrin banne ke dono steps reversible hain magar equilibria bahut daayein taraf hain, is liye zyada tar carbonyl compounds equilibrium par cyanohydrins ki zyada yield dete hain.

book_ref.quote: the equilibria lie far to the right

blocks.prompt:
20 What is formed when 2-hydroxypropanenitrile (from ethanal and HCN) is hydrolysed with dilute acid?
(2-Hydroxypropanenitrile (ethanal aur HCN se) ko dilute acid se hydrolyse karne par kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Nitriles dilute acid se carboxylic acids mein hydrolyse hote hain, is liye –CN group –COOH ban jata hai:
CH₃CH(OH)CN → CH₃CH(OH)COOH (2-hydroxypropanoic acid)

book_ref.quote: to form carboxylic acids or carboxylate ions

blocks.prompt:
21 What are the products of reduction of propanal and of butanone with NaBH₄?
(Propanal aur butanone ko NaBH₄ se reduce karne par kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Aldehydes primary aur ketones secondary alcohols dete hain:
CH₃CH₂CHO + 2[H] → CH₃CH₂CH₂OH (propan-1-ol)
CH₃COCH₂CH₃ + 2[H] → CH₃CH(OH)CH₂CH₃ (butan-2-ol)

book_ref.quote: With a reducing agent such as NaBH₄ or LiAlH₄

blocks.prompt:
22 What does [H] represent in the equations for reduction by NaBH₄?
(NaBH₄ wali reduction ki equations mein [H] kya zahir karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: [H] NaBH₄ se aane wala reducing hydrogen hai jo equation balance karne ke liye brackets mein likha jata hai. Yeh atomic hydrogen nahi; asal hamla karne wala hydride ion, H⁻, hai.

book_ref.quote: It does not represent atomic hydrogen.

blocks.prompt:
23 Why is the reaction of carbonyl compounds with 2,4-DNPH called an addition-elimination (condensation) reaction?
(Carbonyl compounds ka 2,4-DNPH se reaction addition-elimination (condensation) kyun kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: 2,4-Dinitrophenylhydrazine pehle C=O par add hota hai, phir pani ka aik molecule kharij hota hai aur dono molecules jud jate hain (C=N–). Pehle addition phir chhote molecule ka kharij hona ise addition-elimination (condensation) banata hai.

book_ref.quote: Aldehydes or ketones undergo a condensation reaction with 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine

blocks.prompt:
24 How is 2,4-DNPH used to identify aldehydes and ketones? Which carbonyl-containing classes do not respond?
(2,4-DNPH se aldehydes aur ketones kaise pehchane jate hain? Kaun si carbonyl wali classes response nahi detin?)
blocks.explanation: Aldehydes aur ketones wazeh melting points wale orange qalmi 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazones dete hain (jaise ethanal orange ethanal 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazone deta hai). Carboxylic acids, esters, acyl halides aur amides mein >C=O hone ke bawajood yeh test nahi dete.

book_ref.quote: This reagent is used to identify carbonyl compounds.

blocks.prompt:
25 Why are aldehydes easily oxidised while ketones are not?
(Aldehydes aasani se oxidise kyun hote hain jab ke ketones nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Ketone ko oxidise karne ke liye C–C bond torna parta hai, is liye ketones sirf strong oxidising agents se oxidise hote hain. Aldehydes weak aur strong dono oxidising agents se carboxylic acids mein oxidise hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Therefore, ketones are only oxidized by strong oxidizing agents

blocks.prompt:
26 What is Tollens' reagent? Write the equation for its preparation.
(Tollens' reagent kya hai? Is ki tayyari ki equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Tollens' reagent ammoniacal silver nitrate solution hai jis mein aqueous alkaline solution mein silver ions hote hain:
AgNO₃ + 3NH₄OH → [Ag(NH₃)₂]OH + NH₄NO₃ + 2H₂O

book_ref.quote: contains silver ions in aqueous alkaline solution

blocks.prompt:
27 How is the silver mirror formed in Tollens' test? Give its practical use.
(Tollens' test mein silver mirror kaise banta hai? Is ka amli istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Aldehyde ke saath halka garam karne par silver ions silver metal mein reduce ho kar test tube ki deewar par silver mirror bana dete hain. Glucose (aldehydic sugar) ka dilute solution isi tarah gharelu aaine banane mein istemal hota tha.

book_ref.quote: was used to make mirrors for domestic use by means of this reaction

blocks.prompt:
28 What is Fehling's solution? What happens when it is warmed with an aldehyde?
(Fehling's solution kya hai? Aldehyde ke saath garam karne par kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Fehling's solution aqueous alkaline medium mein Cu²⁺ ions ka chamakdar neela solution hai jo tartaric acid ke namak se complex hota hai. Aldehyde ke saath garam karne par Cu²⁺, Cu⁺ mein reduce ho kar copper(I) oxide ka brick-red precipitate banata hai:
R–CHO + 2Cu(OH)₂ + NaOH → R–COO⁻Na⁺ + Cu₂O + 3H₂O

book_ref.quote: complexed with salt of tartaric acid

blocks.prompt:
29 Distinguish between ethanal and propanone by Tollens' and Fehling's tests.
(Tollens' aur Fehling's tests se ethanal aur propanone mein farq karein.)
blocks.explanation: Ethanal (aldehyde) aasani se oxidise hota hai; propanone (ketone) in weak oxidising agents se oxidise nahi hota:

book_ref.quote: Only aldehydes give a positive Tollens' test

rows: Tollens' reagent: silver mirror banta hai
Tollens' reagent: silver mirror nahi banta
Fehling's solution: Cu₂O ka brick-red ppt
Fehling's solution: koi tabdeeli nahi (neela rehta hai)
Ethanoic acid / ethanoate mein oxidise hota hai
Weak oxidising agents se oxidise nahi hota

blocks.prompt:
30 Which carbonyl compounds give the iodoform test? Name the group responsible.
(Kaun se carbonyl compounds iodoform test dete hain? Zimmedar group ka naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Sirf woh jin mein CH₃CO– group (acetyl ya ethanoyl group) ho: aldehydes mein sirf ethanal aur ketones mein sirf methyl ketones (jaise propanone, butanone). I₂ aur NaOH ke saath yeh zard qalmi iodoform, CHI₃, dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Among aldehydes, only ethanal and among ketones, only methyl ketones possess the group CH₃CO-

blocks.prompt:
31 Write the balanced equation for the iodoform reaction of propanone.
(Propanone ke iodoform reaction ki balanced equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
CH₃COCH₃ + 3I₂ + 4NaOH → CHI₃ + CH₃COO⁻Na⁺ + 3NaI + 3H₂O
Zard precipitate iodoform hai; banne wala namak sodium ethanoate hai (sodium methanoate ethanal se banta hai).

book_ref.quote: CH₃COCH₃ + 3I₂ + 4NaOH → CHI₃ + CH₃COO⁻Na⁺ + 3NaI + 3H₂O

blocks.prompt:
32 Why does ethanol give the iodoform test but methanol does not?
(Ethanol iodoform test kyun deta hai jab ke methanol nahi?)
blocks.explanation:
Ethanol mein CH₃–CH(OH)– group hai; alkali mein iodine pehle ise ethanal, CH₃CHO, mein oxidise karti hai jis mein CH₃–C=O group hai aur woh iodoform deta hai:
CH₃CH₂OH + 4I₂ + 6NaOH → CHI₃ + HCOONa + 5NaI + 5H₂O
Methanol se CH₃–C=O wala compound nahi ban sakta, is liye iodoform nahi banta.

book_ref.quote: Methanol cannot give a compound with a CH₃–C=O group, so it gives no iodoform.

blocks.prompt:
33 How many moles of I₂ and NaOH react with 0.20 mol of ethanal in the iodoform reaction?
(Iodoform reaction mein 0.20 mol ethanal ke saath I₂ aur NaOH ke kitne moles react karte hain?)
blocks.explanation:
CH₃CHO + 3I₂ + 4NaOH → CHI₃ + HCOO⁻Na⁺ + 3NaI + 3H₂O
I₂ = 0.20 × 3 = 0.60 mol; NaOH = 0.20 × 4 = 0.80 mol (aur 0.20 mol CHI₃ banta hai).

book_ref.quote: These compounds react with iodine in the presence of sodium hydroxide

blocks.prompt:
34 Give the common names and natural sources of three carboxylic acids.
(Teen carboxylic acids ke aam naam aur qudrati zariye batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Methanoic acid (formic acid) – cheentiyon mein; ethanoic acid (acetic acid) – sirke mein; butanoic acid (butyric acid) – kharab (rancid) makkhan mein.

book_ref.quote: Common examples of carboxylic acids are methanoic acid

blocks.prompt:
35 Why do lower carboxylic acids have high boiling points?
(Chhote carboxylic acids ke boiling points zyada kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: In ke molecules aapas mein hydrogen bonds banate hain (acetic acid ke do molecules hydrogen bonds se dimer bhi bana lete hain). In bonds ko torne ke liye zyada energy chahiye, is liye chhote acids zyada boiling point wale liquids hain (ethanoic acid b.p. 118 °C).

book_ref.quote: Lower carboxylic acids are generally liquids at room temperature, having high boiling points.

blocks.prompt:
36 What is glacial acetic acid? Why does ethanoic acid solidify in winter?
(Glacial acetic acid kya hai? Ethanoic acid sardi mein kyun jam jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ethanoic acid ka melting point 17 °C hai jo room temperature (25 °C) ke qareeb hai, is liye sardi mein jam jata hai. Khalis ethanoic acid ki thos shakal glacier jaisi lagti hai, is liye glacial acetic acid kehlati hai.

book_ref.quote: this is why it solidifies in winter

blocks.prompt:
37 What are fatty acids? Why are they insoluble in water?
(Fatty acids kya hain? Yeh pani mein hal kyun nahi hote?)
blocks.explanation: Lambi chain wale aliphatic monocarboxylic acids fatty acids kehlate hain, jaise stearic, palmitic aur oleic acids, jo vegetable oils mein triglycerides ki shakal mein hote hain. Lambi hydrophobic alkyl chains ki wajah se yeh pani mein hal nahi hote.

book_ref.quote: Stearic acid, palmitic acid, and oleic acid are found in vegetable oils

blocks.prompt:
38 Compare the solubility in water of ethanoic acid and stearic acid.
(Ethanoic acid aur stearic acid ki pani mein hal hone ki salahiyat ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono mein –COOH group hai magar farq yeh hai:

book_ref.quote: Due to their ability to form the hydrogen bond, lower acids

rows: Pani se hydrogen bonds banata hai
Lambi hydrophobic alkyl chain ghalib hai

blocks.prompt:
39 How is propanoic acid prepared from propan-1-ol? Give the conditions.
(Propan-1-ol se propanoic acid kaise banaya jata hai? Conditions batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Propan-1-ol ko zyada acidified KMnO₄ ya acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ ke saath reflux kiya jata hai; yeh pehle propanal aur phir propanoic acid mein oxidise hota hai:
CH₃CH₂CH₂OH + 2[O] → CH₃CH₂COOH + H₂O

book_ref.quote: The starting material is refluxed with excess of either acidified KMnO₄ or acidified K₂Cr₂O₇.

blocks.prompt:
40 In the oxidation of ethanol, how do the conditions decide whether ethanal or ethanoic acid is obtained?
(Ethanol ki oxidation mein conditions kaise tay karti hain ke ethanal milega ya ethanoic acid?)
blocks.explanation: Product conditions se tay hota hai:

book_ref.quote: Oxidation of ethanol and ethanal to ethanoic acid

rows: Oxidant garam ethanol mein qatra qatra dala jata hai

blocks.prompt:
41 How is ethanoic acid obtained from ethanenitrile by alkaline hydrolysis?
(Alkaline hydrolysis se ethanenitrile se ethanoic acid kaise hasil kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Alkali mein nitrile pehle acid ka namak deta hai; phir acidification se azad acid milta hai:
CH₃CN + NaOH + H₂O → CH₃COO⁻Na⁺ + NH₃
CH₃COO⁻Na⁺ + HCl → CH₃COOH + NaCl

book_ref.quote: which yield carboxylic acids on acidification

blocks.prompt:
42 Compare the acid and alkaline hydrolysis of ethyl ethanoate.
(Ethyl ethanoate ki acid aur alkaline hydrolysis ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono mein ester ko reflux kiya jata hai:

book_ref.quote: the ester is hydrolyzed to carboxylic acid or carboxylate ion

rows: Mukammal hota hai (acid namak ban jata hai)
Ethanoic acid ke liye namak ko acidify karein

blocks.prompt:
43 How is benzoic acid prepared from methylbenzene?
(Methylbenzene se benzoic acid kaise banaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Methylbenzene (toluene) acidified KMnO₄ ya K₂Cr₂O₇ se aasani se oxidise hota hai; –CH₃ side chain –COOH ban jati hai:
C₆H₅CH₃ + 3[O] → C₆H₅COOH + H₂O

book_ref.quote: Methyl benzene is readily oxidized by acidified KMnO₄ or K₂Cr₂O₇ to benzoic acid.

blocks.prompt:
44 Name the three types of reactions of carboxylic acids.
(Carboxylic acids ke reactions ki teen qismein batayein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Sirf acidic hydrogen wale reactions (metals, alkalis, carbonates ke saath). (2) –OH group ki tabdeeli wale reactions (SOCl₂, PCl₅, esterification). (3) Poore carboxyl group wale reactions (jaise LiAlH₄ se reduction).

book_ref.quote: Reactions involving the acidic hydrogen only.

blocks.prompt:
45 Write equations for the reaction of ethanoic acid with sodium metal and with sodium carbonate.
(Ethanoic acid ke sodium metal aur sodium carbonate ke saath reactions ki equations likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
2CH₃COOH + 2Na → 2CH₃COO⁻Na⁺ + H₂
2CH₃COOH + Na₂CO₃ → 2CH₃COO⁻Na⁺ + CO₂ + H₂O
Dono is liye hote hain ke acid H⁺ ions deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Carboxylic acids show considerable acidic character because they give H⁺ ions in water.

blocks.prompt:
46 Which gas, and how many moles of it, are given by 0.30 mol of ethanoic acid with excess NaHCO₃?
(0.30 mol ethanoic acid zyada NaHCO₃ ke saath kaun si gas aur kitne mol dega?)
blocks.explanation:
CH₃COOH + NaHCO₃ → CH₃COO⁻Na⁺ + CO₂ + H₂O
Ratio 1 : 1, is liye 0.30 mol CO₂ gas nikalti hai (bulbule).

book_ref.quote: The balanced equation is CH₃–COOH + NaHCO₃ → CH₃–COO⁻Na⁺ + CO₂ + H₂O.

blocks.prompt:
47 Compare the reactions of ethanoic acid with SOCl₂ and with PCl₅.
(Ethanoic acid ke SOCl₂ aur PCl₅ ke saath reactions ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono mein acid ka –OH group Cl se badal kar ethanoyl chloride banta hai:

book_ref.quote: in which the OH group is replaced by some other group like X, OR, NH₂ etc.

blocks.prompt:
48 Write the esterification of methanoic acid with ethanol and name the ester.
(Methanoic acid aur ethanol ki esterification likhein aur ester ka naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Concentrated H₂SO₄ ke saath garam karne par:
HCOOH + C₂H₅OH ⇌ HCOOC₂H₅ + H₂O
Ester ethyl methanoate hai.

book_ref.quote: Reaction with alcohols (Esterification)

blocks.prompt:
49 Which reducing agent reduces ethanoic acid to ethanol? Name two that cannot.
(Kaun sa reducing agent ethanoic acid ko ethanol mein reduce karta hai? Do aise batayein jo nahi kar sakte.)
blocks.explanation:
Taqatwar reducing agent lithium tetrahydridoaluminate(III), LiAlH₄:
CH₃COOH + 4[H] → CH₃CH₂OH + H₂O
H₂/Ni aur sodium tetrahydridoborate(III), NaBH₄, carboxylic acids ko reduce nahi karte.

book_ref.quote: Other common reducing agents H₂/Ni and sodium tetrahydridoborate (III) will not reduce carboxylic acids.

blocks.prompt:
50 Define reduction in terms of hydrogen, oxygen, electrons and oxidation state.
(Hydrogen, oxygen, electrons aur oxidation state ke hawale se reduction ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Reduction: H₂ (ya H⁻) ka izafa, O ya O₂ ka nuqsan, X₂ (halogens) ka nuqsan, electrons ka izafa, aur oxidation state mein kami. Oxidation in sab ka ulat hai.

book_ref.quote: iv. Gain of electrons v. Decrease in Ox state.

blocks.prompt:
51 Which structural feature makes methanoic acid a reducing agent? How is it identified?
(Methanoic acid ki kaun si structure ise reducing agent banati hai? Ise kaise pehchana jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Methanoic acid, H–COOH, mein aldehydic hissa (H–C=O) aur carboxylic hissa dono hain. Yeh weak aur strong oxidising agents se oxidise hota hai, is liye Tollens' ke saath silver mirror aur Fehling's ke saath brick-red ppt deta hai – aisa karne wala wahid monocarboxylic acid.

book_ref.quote: The aldehydic and carboxylic portions of methanoic acid

blocks.prompt:
52 Write the reaction of methanoic acid with Fehling's solution.
(Methanoic acid ka Fehling's solution ke saath reaction likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
H–COOH + 2Cu(OH)₂ → Cu₂O + CO₂ + 3H₂O
Cu₂O brick-red precipitate hai; methanoic acid CO₂ aur pani mein oxidise hota hai.

book_ref.quote: brick red precipitates with Fehling's solution

blocks.prompt:
53 Give the oxidation numbers of Mn and C before and after the reaction of ethanedioic acid with acidified KMnO₄.
(Ethanedioic acid ke acidified KMnO₄ ke saath reaction se pehle aur baad Mn aur C ke oxidation numbers batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
2KMnO₄ + 3H₂SO₄ + 5HOOC–COOH → K₂SO₄ + 2MnSO₄ + 10CO₂ + 8H₂O
Mn: +7 (KMnO₄) → +2 (MnSO₄), reduce. C: +3 (ethanedioic acid) → +4 (CO₂), oxidise.

book_ref.quote: The oxidation of ethanedioic acid with acidified KMnO₄ or K₂Cr₂O₇

blocks.prompt:
54 Arrange RCOOH, ArOH, H₂O and ROH in order of acid strength using their pKa values.
(RCOOH, ArOH, H₂O aur ROH ko pKa values ke mutabiq acid strength ki tarteeb mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Table 23.1 se: RCOOH (pKa 5) > ArOH (pKa 10) > HOH (pKa 14) > R–OH (pKa 16). Kam pKa ka matlab zyada strong acid.

book_ref.quote: phenols are even more acidic than alcohols

blocks.prompt:
55 Define pKa. Calculate the pKa of an acid with Ka = 2.5 × 10⁻⁵.
(pKa ki definition likhein. Ka = 2.5 × 10⁻⁵ wale acid ka pKa nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
pKa = –log Ka; pKa jitna kam, acid utna strong.
pKa = –log(2.5 × 10⁻⁵) = 5 – log 2.5 = 5 – 0.40 = 4.60

book_ref.quote: Higher the Ka or lower the pKa, stronger will be the acid and vice versa.

blocks.prompt:
56 How does delocalisation make the ethanoate ion stable?
(Delocalisation ethanoate ion ko kaise stable banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ethanoate, CH₃COO⁻, mein negative charge –COO⁻ ke carbon aur dono oxygen par phail jata hai, is liye kisi aik oxygen par is ki shiddat kam ho jati hai. Stable ion H⁺ le kar wapas acid banne ka kam imkan rakhta hai, is liye ethanoic acid ionise hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Due to this, the ethanoate ion becomes stabilized

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Charge jitna phaila ho, ion utna sukoon mein (stable) hota hai. Ethanoate mein charge do oxygen par bat jata hai, is liye ion wapas H⁺ pakarne ki jaldi nahi karta – yahi acid ki taqat hai.

blocks.prompt:
57 Differentiate between the effects of +I and –I groups on the acidity of carboxylic acids.
(Carboxylic acids ki acidity par +I aur –I groups ke asraat mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: –COOH se jude group se carboxylate ion ki stability badalti hai:

book_ref.quote: The presence of an electron donating group (+I effect)

rows: Carboxylate ion ko unstable karta hai
Carboxylate ion ko stable karta hai

blocks.prompt:
58 Why is methanoic acid stronger than ethanoic acid?
(Methanoic acid ethanoic acid se strong kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen inductive effects ka reference hai aur is ka –I effect nahi. Ethanoic acid mein CH₃ group ka +I effect ethanoate par negative charge barha kar use unstable karta hai. Is liye methanoic acid takreeban 10 guna strong hai.

book_ref.quote: methanoic acid is 10 times stronger acid than ethanoic acid

blocks.prompt:
59 Calculate the Ka of chloroethanoic acid (pKa 2.86) and of ethanoic acid (pKa 4.74). Which is stronger?
(Chloroethanoic acid (pKa 2.86) aur ethanoic acid (pKa 4.74) ke Ka nikalein. Kaun sa strong hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Ka = 10^–pKa
Chloroethanoic acid: 10^–2.86 = 1.4 × 10⁻³
Ethanoic acid: 10^–4.74 = 1.8 × 10⁻⁵
Chloroethanoic acid ka Ka zyada (takreeban 76 guna) hai, is liye yeh strong hai kyun ke Cl (–I) anion ko stable karta hai.

book_ref.quote: indicating that it is a stronger acid than ethanoic acid (pKa = 4.74)

blocks.prompt:
60 Why is trichloroethanoic acid comparable in strength to some mineral acids?
(Trichloroethanoic acid kuch mineral acids jitna strong kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is mein teen electronegative Cl atoms hain, har aik ka –I effect hai, jo mil kar carboxylate ion ka negative charge bahut phailate aur use stable karte hain. Is ka pKa 0.64 tak gir jata hai (ethanoic acid 4.74), jo kuch mineral acids jaisa hai.

book_ref.quote: Trichloroacetic acid (Cl₃C-COOH) has a pKa of 0.64

blocks.prompt:
61 What are esters? Give two uses.
(Esters kya hain? Do istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Esters carboxylic acids ke derivatives hain jo un ke alcohols se reaction se bante hain, jaise ethyl ethanoate, CH₃COOC₂H₅. Istemal: solvents ke taur par, aur fruit drinks aur mithaiyon mein flavouring agents (phalon ki khushbu aur zaiqa esters se hai).

book_ref.quote: Esters are the derivatives of carboxylic acids that are obtained by their reactions with alcohols.

blocks.prompt:
62 Why is the boiling point of ethyl ethanoate (77 °C) lower than that of ethanoic acid (118 °C)?
(Ethyl ethanoate ka boiling point (77 °C) ethanoic acid (118 °C) se kam kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Carboxylic acids aur alcohols ke bar-aks esters apne molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds nahi bana sakte, is liye unhein alag karne mein kam energy lagti hai. Is liye ethyl ethanoate kam temperature par ubalta aur zyada volatile hai.

book_ref.quote: This is why their boiling points are lower than the corresponding alcohols and carboxylic acids.

blocks.prompt:
63 Compare ethyl ethanoate with ethanoic acid in hydrogen bonding, boiling point and solubility.
(Ethyl ethanoate aur ethanoic acid ka hydrogen bonding, boiling point aur solubility mein muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq is liye hai ke sirf acid hydrogen bonds banata hai:

book_ref.quote: A lower boiling point means a higher volatility.

blocks.prompt:
64 What is Fischer's esterification? Give one example.
(Fischer's esterification kya hai? Aik misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Acidic medium mein carboxylic acid aur alcohol ke reaction se ester aur pani banna Fischer's esterification hai. Yeh equilibrium hai. Misaal:
CH₃CH₂COOH + C₂H₅OH ⇌ CH₃CH₂COOC₂H₅ (ethyl propanoate) + H₂O

book_ref.quote: This reaction is known as Fischer's esterification.

blocks.prompt:
65 Differentiate between preparing an ester from a carboxylic acid and from an acyl chloride.
(Ester ko carboxylic acid se aur acyl chloride se banane mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono alcohol se react kar ke ester dete hain:

book_ref.quote: Acyl chlorides react vigorously with alcohols to form esters

blocks.prompt:
66 Write the hydrolysis of ethyl benzoate.
(Ethyl benzoate ki hydrolysis likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Aromatic esters bhi aliphatic esters ki tarah (acid ya base catalysed) hydrolyse ho kar aryl carboxylic acid aur alcohol dete hain:
C₆H₅COOC₂H₅ + H₂O → C₆H₅COOH + C₂H₅OH

book_ref.quote: Aromatic esters are also hydrolysed in the same manner

blocks.prompt:
67 What are acyl chlorides? Give their general formula and name CH₃COCl.
(Acyl chlorides kya hain? In ka general formula likhein aur CH₃COCl ka naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Acyl chlorides ka functional group –COCl hai; saturated aliphatic acyl chlorides ka general formula CₙH₂ₙ₊₁COCl hai. IUPAC mein inhein alkanoyl halides kehte hain: CH₃COCl ethanoyl chloride hai.

book_ref.quote: Saturated aliphatic acyl chlorides have the general formula CₙH₂ₙ₊₁COCl.

blocks.prompt:
68 Why are acyl chlorides used to prepare other functional derivatives of carboxylic acids?
(Acyl chlorides carboxylic acids ke doosre functional derivatives banane mein kyun istemal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Acyl chlorides carboxylic acids ke functional derivatives mein sab se reactive hain, is liye aasani se react karte hain (jaise alcohols aur phenol se esters, pani se acids) aur doosre derivatives banane ke liye tayyar kiye jate hain.

book_ref.quote: they are usually prepared in such a way that they can be used for the preparation of other functional derivatives

blocks.text: 23.9 Hydrolysis of Acyl Chlorides, Alkyl Chlorides and Aryl Chlorides

blocks.prompt:
69 Why is ethanoyl chloride hydrolysed within a few minutes?
(Ethanoyl chloride chand minutes mein kyun hydrolyse ho jata hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Is ka carbonyl carbon do bahut electronegative atoms, O aur Cl, se juda hai jin ka strong electron withdrawing effect use bara δ⁺ deta hai. Is liye H₂O ka nucleophilic hamla bahut tez hai:
CH₃COCl + H₂O → CH₃COOH + HCl

book_ref.quote: due to the strong electron withdrawing effect of two highly electronegative atoms

blocks.prompt:
70 Why does chlorobenzene not undergo hydrolysis like chloroethane?
(Chlorobenzene chloroethane ki tarah hydrolyse kyun nahi hota?)
blocks.explanation: Chlorobenzene mein C–Cl wala carbon benzene ring ka hissa hai. Chlorine ka lone pair ring ke π electrons ke saath delocalise hota hai aur C–Cl bond mein double bond character aa jata hai. Bond itna mazboot ho jata hai ke nahi toot-ta.

book_ref.quote: lone pair on chlorine participates in delocalization

blocks.prompt:
71 Differentiate between ethanoyl chloride and chloroethane in the ease of hydrolysis.
(Hydrolysis ki aasani mein ethanoyl chloride aur chloroethane ka farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono mein pani nucleophile ban kar δ⁺ carbon par hamla karta hai:

book_ref.quote: In ethyl chloride, the carbon gets comparatively less partial positive charge

rows: Carbon O aur Cl se juda
